packageRules.description: Automerged updates wait 3 days after release (the age Renovate's own security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm preset uses), so a hijacked release is usually yanked or flagged before it lands in main. The top-level internalChecksFilter strict (the docs' recommendation with minimumReleaseAge) makes a still-pending version be skipped, not merged.

The python-version datasource has no release timestamps, so under the default minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour (timestamp-required) a Python patch would stay pending forever. It is raised without the age check and, since nothing vouches for its age, is not automerged.
The github-runners datasource has no release timestamps either, so the 3 day age check would keep a runner image bump pending forever. Raised without the age check and not automerged.

A Python minor (3.14 -> 3.15) is a runtime upgrade for every instance that runs Python as its app runtime: its own runtime Dockerfile must move in step, and its tools must support the new version. This one rule covers the devcontainer's PYTHON_VERSION, the Makefile's PYTHON_VERSION and pyproject.toml's requires-python, so they move in one PR. The UV_IMAGE tag also carries the Python minor, which no manager rewrites: the Makefile guard fails that PR until the tag and digest are moved by hand. Keep it out of the automerged group, as its own PR for manual review.

Pin container images to their digest. Scoped to the docker managers on purpose: a global pinDigests also hits the pre-commit manager, whose tag revs can't be converted to digests (the update fails). GitHub Actions are pinned by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests instead.

The uv version appears in the Makefile (UV_VERSION and the UV_IMAGE tag) and the devcontainer (UV_VERSION ARG); tests/unit/test_release_contract.py and a Makefile guard fail if they drift, so they move in one PR.
Renovate can't regenerate .devcontainer/devcontainer-lock.json, so features are bumped by hand together with it (see .devcontainer/README.md).

customManagers.description: The uv and syft images pinned by tag and digest in the Makefile (UV_IMAGE, SYFT_IMAGE); Renovate updates both. The UV_IMAGE tag also carries the Python minor and variant, which the Python minor rule does not rewrite: a Makefile guard fails until it is moved by hand.
requires-python's lower bound (>=3.14) moves with the Python minor in the Makefile's uv image tag and the devcontainer; the python minor rule groups all three into one PR.
